limitations: Real \(1<p<\infty\) sums with a Daugavet Banach component and an atomic \(\ell_1\) component; the general expression is an explicit scalar minimization, with a closed-form phase law only for the indicated Hilbert sum.
scientific_integrity: Analytic slice proof, independently recomputed scalar inequalities and boundary cases; finite exact checks are supplementary and do not establish the general theorem. Literature search cannot establish exhaustive novelty.
title: Exact pointwise Daugavet constants in mixed \(\ell_p\)–\(\ell_1\) sums
